source_snapshot.procedure: Generic setup says clear logs; open Dashboard and Server Health > Sensor Reading.
source_snapshot.criteria: Sensor reading and threshold are human readable and match specification.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES passes the entire FAN1_R~FAN16_R expression as one literal sensor name and truncates fallback SDR output, so it cannot prove sixteen distinct records, suffix meaning, physical fan/rotor mapping, tach scaling, thresholds or UI parity.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION correctly demands separate records, authoritative R semantics, physical fan/controller mapping, full untruncated evidence and no cooling mutation, but leaves those Project inputs as a review Pending condition.

old_problem: The tilde range is not proven IPMI sensor syntax, `_R` is undefined by the source, and a single or truncated response could be mistaken for sixteen physical speed channels. Static RPM has no valid PASS basis without fan/rotor/controller identity, tach scaling, current fan-control state and approved state-specific limits.
disposition_reason: The review-layer method is complete without inventing whether R means rear, redundant, reported or another platform term: retain every exact R-labeled identity, require the Project dictionary and fan/controller map at runtime, enumerate and read all sixteen records independently, correlate each with both UI locations and judge only against approved state-specific RPM/threshold/freshness rules. Missing Project bindings make execution NOT READY rather than keeping the engineering review Pending.
decision_basis: XLSX row 895, its same-row DeepSeek fields, exact GPT V2 record, selection manifest, paired row 896 `_F`, related history and preserved V3.1 record were directly reviewed.
The paired `_F` family makes a front/rear rotor interpretation plausible but not authoritative; neither suffix may be expanded without the platform fan drawing or controller definition.
Standard IPMI SDR inventory can support read-only discovery, but the literal range and OEM/controller parameters are not portable and may not be guessed.

ED-03 prohibits guessed OEM parameters, ED-15 prohibits PASS without approved limits, ED-17 preserves logs and ED-20 requires all sixteen R identities to remain distinct from all sixteen F identities.

test_case.test_name: Verify SPD_FAN1_R through SPD_FAN16_R as sixteen independently mapped speed channels
test_case.purpose: Verify every defined SPD_FAN1_R through SPD_FAN16_R record is separately human readable in Dashboard and Server Health, maps to its authoritative physical fan/rotor or controller channel, and reports the correct speed, units, health, supported thresholds and freshness for the unchanged current cooling-control state.
required_package: Chassis, fan-board/controller and BMC build plus the authoritative definitions of SPD_FAN, suffix `_R` and the separate `_F` family
Sixteen-row mapping from exact source token to physical fan module, rotor or other Project-defined channel, thermal zone, airflow direction, fan PN/serial and controller/tach input
Controller/bus/channel identity, tach pulses-per-revolution and scaling plus stable SDR/API and Dashboard/Server Health names
Approved RPM units/rounding/tolerance, threshold capability/values/hysteresis, health, polling/freshness and stale/no-reading rules for each supported control state
Current fan mode, PWM duty/target RPM, thermal zone, power/load, inlet/ambient, altitude and airflow context
Rules for empty/unfitted channels, stopped or missing rotor, front/R mismatch, duplicate/swapped identity and degraded cooling
Validated protected read-only BMC/browser client and pinned immutable reviewed `sensor.git` revision/checksum or approved manual method
test_case.test_command: Do not clear SEL, BMC, kernel or thermal logs and do not change fan policy/PWM, remove or reseat fans, obstruct airflow, start load, alter thresholds or write the controller. First bind each exact SPD_FAN1_R through SPD_FAN16_R token to the approved Project suffix/channel map; never infer R from its letter. Enumerate the complete SDR/API repository and resolve all sixteen exact records separately; do not submit the tilde expression as one sensor unless that syntax is explicitly documented. Review the Script before use. Capture each record's immutable identity, physical mapping, RPM/value, units, status, supported threshold fields and timestamp with the matching Dashboard and Server Health row and simultaneous fan mode/PWM target/load/ambient context. Compare only with the approved state-specific rule. Stop without retry on missing, duplicate, swapped, stale or divergent evidence.
test_case.expected_result: All sixteen R-labeled source identities have explicit, authoritative and mutually distinct outcomes. Every applicable record and both UI views agree on the mapped physical/controller channel, speed, units, health, supported thresholds and freshness, and each speed satisfies the approved rule for its recorded cooling-control state. `_F`, aggregate fan data, a count, one sample or an assumed rear-rotor meaning never substitutes.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires sixteen explicit outcomes, an approved `_R` dictionary and fan/controller/tach map, complete independent OOB/two-UI evidence and engineer acceptance against per-state speed, threshold, status and freshness rules. A literal range result, truncated inventory, aggregate value, generic RPM limit, label-only match or `_F` evidence cannot pass. Missing/swapped/duplicate/stale identity, wrong scaling/unit, out-of-rule speed or required threshold/status/UI mismatch is FAIL. Missing Project semantics, mapping, state rules or reviewed access is NOT READY, not Engineering Decision Pending or PASS; fan-fault stimulus and control response remain outside this passive display case.
safety_gate: Preserve SEL, BMC, kernel and thermal evidence; do not perform the source's generic clear-log step.
Enumerate sixteen exact records; do not treat the tilde expression, a count, aggregate fan object or the separate `_F` family as coverage.
Do not infer `_R` semantics or OEM controller parameters and do not apply one RPM rule across different fan modes, models or environments.
Do not change PWM/fan policy, remove/reseat/stop a fan, block airflow, add thermal load, alter thresholds or write the controller.
Do not truncate output, expose credentials or execute an unpinned/unreviewed Script; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Chassis/fan-board/controller/BMC identity and approved SPD_FAN/`_R`/`_F` definitions
Sixteen-row exact-token to physical module/rotor-or-channel/zone/PN/serial/controller-tach mapping with pulses-per-revolution/scaling
Complete separate SDR/API readings for all sixteen R-labeled channels with RPM/value, units, thresholds, state and synchronized timestamps plus matching Dashboard and Server Health visual evidence
Simultaneous fan mode, PWM duty/target, load, inlet/ambient, altitude and airflow with the applied state-specific rule
Explicit empty/missing/stopped/duplicate/swapped/stale/front-R mismatch disposition and reviewed Script/tool audit
No-clear/no-fan-or-airflow-or-load-or-threshold change/no-retry proof, final BMC/cooling health and per-channel engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: No mutation is expected. On unknown suffix/channel semantics, mapping ambiguity, stale/divergent telemetry or unexpected cooling/BMC health change, stop and preserve first-pass evidence and the unchanged fan-control/environment state. Obtain the authoritative fan/controller definition and use approved read-only diagnostics; do not manipulate fans, airflow, load or controls to force a result. Any separately authorized fan or power action requires its own safety and recovery plan.

source_conflict.reason: Items, both UI paths and Criteria consistently request passive speed-sensor display/spec validation. The undefined suffix and range syntax are Project execution bindings, not contradictory source purposes.

blocked.reason: The passive sixteen-channel purpose and a safe parameterized method are clear. Project fan/controller documentation can supply suffix, topology, scaling and acceptance bindings without changing the review decision.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Authoritative `_R`/`_F` semantics, sixteen physical fan/rotor-or-channel/controller mappings, tach scaling, stable sensor/UI IDs, per-state speed/threshold/status/freshness rules, cooling context and protected reviewed method.
